title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Trusted Authority Presentation and Semantic-Spoof Resistance Extension

new_primitives.TRUSTED_PRESENTATION_LAYER_ID: Non-model presentation component responsible for rendering verified authority status.
new_primitives.DISPLAY_BINDING: Binding between visible instruction, commit identity, action scope and verified authority metadata.
new_primitives.DETACHED_CONTENT_STATUS: Status applied when content is copied away from its verified presentation context.
new_primitives.PORTABLE_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT: Reverifiable object capable of carrying authority provenance across presentation contexts.

core_rule: Model-generated text may describe authority but may never constitute or render the trusted proof of that authority.
verification_requirements: stale face generates perfect visual/linguistic imitation of committed instruction
trusted UI refuses authority badge without current metadata
valid commit receives badge only from presentation layer
copy plain text and verify automatic authority downgrade
copy portable receipt and verify authority can be restored only after revalidation
screenshot is treated as display evidence rather than live authority proof
canonical_lines: Content may claim authority; only the trusted presentation path may attest it.
The string VERIFIED is data, not verification.
Authority detached from its receipt becomes unverified until proven again.
